faq.question: Is Umair Jibran available for hire?
faq.answer: Yes. He is open to full-time remote engineering roles, and open to relocating for the right team in Europe or North America. The quickest route is email or a 30-minute call — both are linked from this page.

faq.question: Where is he based, and does remote work actually overlap?
faq.answer: He works from Peshawar, Pakistan (UTC+5). That is a full working-day overlap with European teams and a solid morning overlap with North America, and he has shipped production work on distributed teams for the last four years.

faq.question: What does he actually build?
faq.answer: Backend systems and the infrastructure under them: Node.js and Python services, event-driven and serverless architectures on AWS and GCP, observability with Datadog, and agentic LLM workflows. At PuppyDog.io he is the sole backend, DevOps, and AI/ML engineer, and also manages two frontend engineers and a QA engineer.

faq.question: Which integrations has he shipped?
faq.answer: CRM and GTM tools including HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, and SmartLead; automation through n8n and custom webhook workers; Slack bots and slash commands; Google services such as Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and Sheets; GitHub Apps, Actions, and webhooks; plus the plumbing underneath — inbound and outbound webhooks, signature verification, WebSockets, idempotency, and rate-limit backoff. Niche or in-house APIs are usually the same job with a different contract.

faq.question: What has he measurably delivered?
faq.answer: He built a mass personalization engine that scaled from 10 to 10,000+ prospects per job unattended, led a hybrid AWS to GCP migration that cut infrastructure cost by 36%, redesigned a media pipeline down to 11 independent services and roughly 80% lower monthly infra cost, and took backend test coverage from 0 to about 75% — which moved releases from fortnightly to daily.

faq.question: How should a recruiter or hiring manager start?
faq.answer: Email me@umairjibran.com or book a slot on the scheduling link. A PDF resume is linked in the site header, deeper write-ups live on the writing site, and the code is on GitHub.
